talents.name: Deadly Aspects
talents.description: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Endurance Training
talents.description: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.

talents.name: Focused Fire
talents.description: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.

talents.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
talents.description: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 6%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

talents.name: Pathfinding
talents.description: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.

talents.name: Improved Revive Pet
talents.description: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.

talents.name: Bestial Swiftness
talents.description: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

talents.name: Unleashed Fury
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Mend Pet
talents.description: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.

talents.name: Ferocity
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 10%.

talents.name: Summon Hawk
talents.description: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 32 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

talents.name: Spirit Bond
talents.description: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.

talents.name: Intimidation
talents.description: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

talents.name: Bestial Discipline
talents.description: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 20% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Frenzy
talents.description: Gives your pet a 100% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

talents.name: Bestial Wrath
talents.description: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

talents.name: Hawk Eye
talents.description: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

talents.name: Improved Concussive Shot
talents.description: Gives your Concussive Shot a 20% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Lethal Attacks
talents.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Stings
talents.description: Increased the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.

talents.name: Efficiency
talents.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

talents.name: Careful Aim
talents.description: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Rapid Killing
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Arcane Shot
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

talents.name: Lone Wolf
talents.description: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

talents.name: Trueshot Aura
talents.description: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yards by 30. Lasts 30 min.

talents.name: Mortal Shots
talents.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

talents.name: Rapid Recuperation
talents.description: Hitting a target with your Serpent Sting ability grants you 50% and consuming Rapid Killing grants you 100% of your Mana regeneration while casting for the next 15 sec.

talents.name: Barrage
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Scatter Shot
talents.description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

talents.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
talents.description: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.

talents.name: Sniper Shot
talents.description: A steady snipe that increases ranged damage by 160.

talents.name: Improved Tracking
talents.description: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.description: Increases your Parry chance by 10%.

talents.name: Entrapment
talents.description: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

talents.name: Savage Strikes
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 4%.

talents.name: Survivalist
talents.description: Increases your total Health by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Wing Clip
talents.description: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Clever Traps
talents.description: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.

talents.name: Surefooted
talents.description: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.

talents.name: Deterrence
talents.description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Survival Tactics
talents.description: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Predator's Edge
talents.description: Increases your melee critical strike damage by 30% and your offhand weapon damage by 50%.

talents.name: Counterattack
talents.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 13 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

talents.name: Resourcefulness
talents.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Trap abilities and melee abilities by 60%. In addition, your critical strikes have a 60% chance to allow 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

talents.name: Expose Prey
talents.description: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec.

talents.name: Survivalist's Discipline
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.

talents.name: Strider Kick
talents.description: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.description: Increases your Agility by 15%.

talents.name: Lacerating Strikes
talents.description: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage over 21 sec equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite.
